label: Flooded area (monthly, Sentinel-1 SAR)
colormap: continuous red -> white -> green (red = low / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = high / increase); 2nd-98th percentile of all dates
native_resolution: 10 m Sentinel-1 RTC read at 160 m, classified on a 0.004 deg (~440 m) grid
source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 IW GRD RTC (sentinel-1-rtc) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
notes: Share of each ~1.3 km cell classified as flooded (vegetation/land under water; permanent open water excluded), as % of the observed (or gap-filled) area: the same definition as the county series flood_s1_flood_pct. Transparent = no flooding; black hatching = no Sentinel-1 acquisition within 2 months.
smoothing: average of the grid cells in each display pixel
transparent: zero / none (and the colour scale starts at the lowest non-zero values)
